batting.name: S Sohal
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b RJ Harris

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c Sunny Singh b PC Valthaty

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c R McLaren b PP Chawla

batting.name: JP Duminy
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b R McLaren

batting.name: B Chipli
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b PC Valthaty

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c DB Ravi Teja b A Mishra

batting.name: PC Valthaty
batting.dismissal: c I Sharma b A Mishra

balls.text: good delivery to end, full and outside off stump, squeezed away to point
full toss around off, Steyn cannot get underneath it and swings it down to long off
full and outside off stump, Steyn misses as he backs away and then tries to squeeze it away
looks to launch a full delivery out of the ground, but cannot connect cleanly, they pinch the single even as the bowler rushes towards the ball
full toss driven towards mid off, there is a misfield and they come back for the second
shuffles across and outside the line of this short one, and pulls it away in the air fine on the leg side

yet another wicket for Paul, what is happening, Mishra went outside off and went for the scoop over short fine leg, misses the ball and was struck on the pads, umpire thinks that is a goner, and Paul is grinning widely
Dan misses and Paul hits, went for the big slog down the ground, missed the length ball and Paul hits the top of off stump
cannot get this one away, fuller and he pushes it down the track
Dan goes big over wide long off, that;s what he has been picked for, stands in the crease and smacks a fuller one in to the crowd
goes hard at a length ball, and the outside edge flies wide of short third man
slower and fuller one around middle leg, squeezed away to long on
goes for the big sweep over fine leg, but misses this one down the leg side
good shot, he hung back in the crease looking for the fuller one, it arrived wide outside off and he drilled it past cover
some innovation from Dan, reaches out to a wide full toss outside off and swings it somehow to the straight boundary
tries the same delivery again, this time he goes back and pushes it away in front of point
McLaren goes through Gony's defenses first ball, angled in on the stumps from a length, Gony is caught in the crease and misses the line of the ball, middle stumps gets uprooted
good ball from McLaren, slower one wide outside off, he stretches out and squeezes it away to sweeper cover
Dan smokes a short one away, gets the pull out of the middle of the bat and sends it flat and over deep midwicket, it;s a no ball as well

Duminy is gone, this is a big wicket for Punjab, looked to drill a fuller one over the straight boundary, played a bit early and spooned it high up in the air for Piyush at long off to settle under it and take it cleanly
100.2 kph, comes forward early and then checks the drive along the ground to long off
worked away down the ground to long on this time
98.5 kph slower one and full around off, he pushes it away to the bowler
gets across to one very full and angled in on the pads, flicks it past short fine leg
swerves away slightly in the air from outside off stump, turned away down the ground on the leg side
backs away and cuts this one going across him to sweeper cover
opens the face and runs down another one to third man
that deft guide off the stumps from JP, Malik overruns the ball at third man, then puts out the left hand to stop the ball, but it beats him in to the boundary
comes forward and across and turns this one for a single as midwicket fails to cut it off
nicely done, stays back and makes room to guide one from middle stump to third man
worked away from the crease towards square leg
hit on the pads as he misses the flick, they take the leg bye even as the bowler appeals in vain, pitched outside leg probably
eased down to long off

Chipli chips in the air wide of long on this time, but the fielder runs in from deep midwicket and takes it cleanly, Valthaty strikes again, it was the split finger slower one, like Dilhara Fernando bowls
goes inside out off a length ball, but the man running to his left from long off fails to hold on
now he appeal for lbw, Chipli looked to slog over midwicket but misses and was struck on the pads, maybe going down leg
dragged widish across the batsman, slapped away to sweeper cover
angled in fuller around off stump, hit away down to long on, it was the slower one
worked away towards midwicket
Chipli goes big wide of deep midwicket, gets front leg across and mows the flighted leg break to the boundary
on the front foot and smashed down to long off
driven down to long on
tossed up juicy full toss around off stump, he works it away through midwicket
skids on across the left-hander, pushed away wide of extra cover
comes well forward again and pushes neatly on the off side, but extra cover cuts it off
Chipli creams this one off the front foot but finds extra cover
good delivery skidding on middle stump, he goes deep in the crease to work it through midwicket
gets forward to push a length ball past cover
length ball around middle and leg, worked away towards long on
flicks away backward of square leg off the back foot
very full on the stumps, pushed back towards the bowler, Valthaty starts off with a wicket and only four runs in his first over
well, well, when it goes your way, it goes all the way, a foot outside leg stump, and he sweeps it straight to short fine leg
played away close to the wicket
flicked away through square leg off the back foot
driven down the ground to long off
slanted across on a very full length, dug away back to the bowler
well, he hasn't bowled particularly well this over, but he gets a wicket, Sanga goes down on the knee for the slog sweep, but hits it straight to deep midwicket
Shaun Marsh at extra cover with a brilliant diving stop, another short one and he slammed it off the back foot, but Marsh got quickly to his left
tosses this one up, but Shikhar drives with the turn to long on
another googly, but a touch shortish, turning across from leg, he slaps it to sweeper cover
the wrong 'un, he reads it off the pitch as it is a touch short and punches it to long off
first ball he brings out the reverse sweep, flat leg break outside off and Shikhar beats a diving point with the shot
tries the sweep from outside off, on the bounce to deep square leg
makes room and chips in the air to long off
Sanga makes room and slashes this short and wide one, gets it high in the air wide of short third man
109.4 kph, he comes forward and eases it down to long off
flicks this one on the pads through square leg
gets away with a waist high full toss outside off,  a surprised Sanga mows it wide of deep midwicket, but does not time it well
comes forward and looks to drive a length ball but it is too close to him and he checks the shot to extra cover
shuffles across and turns this one to short fine leg, but they cross over for the single
low full toss around off stump, he pushes it down to long off
Shikhar goes big over midwicket, it was fuller around the off stump, and he swung it over the boundary
stays on the back foot and works it away to square leg
misses the clip off the pads, but Sanga is alert and pushes Dhawan for the run
slapped hard off the front foot to long off
pulled away through midwicket, short ball and Shikhar gets on top of it, swinging on one leg and dismissing it to the boundary
tucked away off the pads to deep midwicket
142.6 kph short delivery banged in, he goes down underneath it
Sanga bends the knee and comfortably beats extra cover with the drive, mid off chases it down
swings hard at one that is wide outside off, gets it off the inner half wide of mid on, and has to dive in as the throw comes in
gets away with one short down leg, Dhawan swivels and pulls hard, but straight to fine leg
this time he gets down on a knee and slams this widish one to sweeper cover
beats Sanga with a length ball that goes across him outside off, he went for the drive and missed
goes hard again at one that is pitched wider outside off, and gets it away to sweeper cover
slanted across full, he comes forward and smashes it, but there is a man at short extra cover and it goes right to him
starts off short down the leg side, tucked away off the back foot to fine leg

now it is Dhawan, McLaren goes fullish on the pads again, Shikhar shuffles and goes in front of square leg with the wristy flick, there is man at deep square leg, he runs across but it is too quick for him
goes for the big drive over cover to one that is pitched fuller around off, gets a thick edge that flies in the air to third man
as if on auto pilot, he gets nicely forward to a length ball going across him and drives it to mid off, lovely player to watch
Sanga is waiting this time, McLaren bowls this one down the pads in search of the swing, Sanga stands in the crease and clips it past square leg with minimum fuss
another peach, this one slides across from a fuller length, and raps him on the pads, probably pitching outside leg
lovely ball first up, swinging in to the pads, hits him there on the full, not given, maybe going down leg
bashed! this time Sanga does the charge, takes this one on the half volley and slams it hard past the non-striker
that was close, Sanga shuffled across to work this one on leg stump past square leg, took it high on the pad and the ball rolled close to the stumps
PK is not happy, misfield at cover, Sanga came forward to a length ball and eased it to that man's left, some bad bounce for him though, Harris cannot pull it back with the dive
charges down the track in search of the inside out drive past extra cover, cannot beat a diving Karthik
this time Dhawan gets the quick run, gets forward, pushes wide of Dinesh at mid off and rushes across
pushed again with soft hands to mid off and Sanga charges across for the run, well done
played back to the bowler
this time gives him lots of width outside off, and Shikhar goes hard at it, and gets the cut between cover and point
plonks the ball in front of extra cover with soft hands and takes the fielder on with the quick single, makes it comfortably
gets nicely behind this one and pushes it away towards covers
looks to punch a short of a length ball from the crease, gets an inside edge that beats Gilchrist, maybe five years ago, Gilly would have got to it, too quick for him now
stays in the crease and eases one that is angled across to cover
closer to off, pushed away to extra cover
Sanga shows how it is done, gets front foot out and launches in to this one going across him outside off, extra cover dives but the ball beats him and races away
just outside off stump from a length, tight stuff from PK, left alone
bowls one full across the left-hander who drives hard but cannot time it past extra cover
another one zipping away off the seam from a length on middle, he pushes it back to PK
moves away from round the wicket, he gets forward and defends around off
makes room outside leg and smokes one full around middle and leg, but slams it straight at a nice catchable height to mid off
gives him the short one, climbs quickly on to him, he goes for the pull half-heartedly and the ball loops away wide of midwicket
slightly fuller and angled across, he gets it past cover this time but he manages to slow it down as he gets a hand to it
comes forward this time to a length ball going across him and pushes it, but cover dives to his right to stop it
138.2 kph another full one just outside off he pushes it away to point
pacy ball full on the pads, whipped away furiously to fine leg who is a bit square
close to off stump, but a touch short of a length, he slashes hard and gets it down to third man
lovely delivery, angled in from round the stumps, pitches off and zips away, hangs back, covers for the movement, and guides it to third man
bowls this one fuller and gets it to move away in the air, he cautiously pushes it away
with the left-hander on strike, PK gets the ball to move away from him as well from a length, he pushes it just past extra cover
this one is closer to off on a length and moves away, he stays in the crease and opens the face to run it to third man
no wicket first ball this time for PK, Sunny is away, sprays this one full and wide outside off, he adjusts for the away swing and chips it way over covers, and the ball runs in to the boundary

appeal for leg-before, Deccan haven't had anything going their way, full toss that Nayar swipes across the line and misses, they scramble for the leg-bye, that was very close, Dan cannot believe it, but Punjab are home
swivels and goes for another pull, the top edge flies over the keeper in to the boundary
Nayar goes for the pull off the front foot, bends the back leg, and hammers it past deep square leg
angled in on the pads, worked away off the back foot behind square leg
this time he hops and keeps the short one down in front of point and Nayar lumbers across for the single
Dinesh hops in the air to keep down a sharply rising short one from Ishant, tries to go for the single but the ball was close to the stumps
Nayar swings on one leg for a ferocious pull off a short one on leg, but hits it straight to deep square leg
Nayar walks across the stumps and shovels a length ball past midwicket for a couple
dropped short and wide, Dinesh cuts it hard off the back foot, but point drops the sharp diving chance to his left, JP Duminy it was who went leaping but could not hold on
hullo, Dinesh gives Ishant a blind charge and is beaten completely outside off stump
he is gone finally, looked to belt another one over long on, but could not time it well, Iishant took a well-judged catch running to his left from long on
connects alright this time, down the track, and slams this flat delivery wide of long off for another boundary
looks to repeat the shot, doesn't pick the googly and is beaten
Paul doing it again for Punjab, goes down on the knee and slog-sweeps from outside off stump and high over deep midwicket
Nayar comes out of his crouching stance down the track, but only manages to push it away off the pads in front of extra cover
driven hard off the front foot, extra cover cannot stop it cleanly
gets a short and wide one and slaps it wide of sweeper cover for a couple
defends this one on a length outside off
walks across and chops a length ball close to the stumps, does not know where the ball has gone as he looks around
beats him outside off stump with a pacy ball that angles across him even as he pushes forward
slapped away over the bowler to long off
bangs this one short, and Paul gets out of the way

Mishra gets Gilly with a flat half-tracker, Gilly pulls it straight to deep square leg, he did not have to move at all, Mishra gives him a send-off, gesturing towards the dressing room, Gilly acknowledges the generous applause as he walks back
worked away off the pads through midwicket, Paul comes back for the second, and just makes it
another googly, but a touch short, he goes back and pushes it back to the bowler
fuller one, slogged away down to long off
misreads the googly, throws his bat playing for the leg break, struck on the pads outside leg, ball loops away to slip
turning in from middle stump, goes back and pushes it for a single down to long on
another one, this guy is in some touch, comes down the track and smokes a full delivery way above long off,
slapped away wide of point who does well to dive and stop the ball, it was Chipli
mistimes the pull off a shortish but quicker one to long on
works this one on the pads in front of square leg
swipes this one through midwicket off the back foot, he is going at everything
Paul takes off straight down the ground, and gets to his 50, long off was interested till the end but the ball just beat him over the ropes
whipped off the pads wide of fine leg by Gilly for a couple
now the slower one, lovely stuff from Steyn, he was early in to the drive, but long off is right on the boundary, and extra cover cannot get to it
Paul getting the working over from the world's premier pacer, bouncer this time and he ducks quickly
and again, this time he hops in the air and throws his bat at this short of a good length delivery but it bounces high over his blade
furious delivery, moving away from short of a length, Paul looks to hammer it through point, too quick for him at 149.4 kph
slower one this time around off stump, Gilly stays in the crease and steers it to third man
Sanga goes flying to his right to take a pacy length ball sprayed wide down leg by Steyn
fires in another one, a touch short and Gilly looks for the pull, but it hurries on to him and he mistimes it in slowly in the air to long on
fired in around leg stump, Gilly gets in to a tangle and cannot work it away
pushed back to the bowler
nothing is going right for Deccan, Gilly goes down for the big sweep, but the ball flies past Sanga, Ishant runs hard and clumsily puts in the dive, landing hard on the ground
fired wide down the leg side from round the stumps
slammed off the front foot to long off
shuffles and works this one from middle and leg down the ground
looks to work this one fine on the leg side, but does not connect cleanly
good ball from Mishra, slides it wide and short across Adam as he sees him charging out, he adjusts to reach out and slap it away on the bounce to sweeper cover
played away towards covers
pushed back to the bowler
Gilly finds his range, and it lies beyond the boundary, comes out and lofts a flighted one straight down the ground, 50 for him
turns in to Adam who cannot work it away
slides on quickly from back of a length, he stays back and punches in the air to long off
this is really poor bowling, consistently full and wide outside off, Gilly hammers it wide of sweeper cover and he gets nowhere near it
meets the ball with a straight bat but cannot beat a diving extra cover
another full toss wide outside off, gets away this time as Gilly slaps it straight to Ravi Teja at sweeper cover
squeezes a wide and full one past point, sweeper cover tries a football style diving tackle, gets legs to the ball, but it trickles over the ropes
in to the second tier goes Adam, length ball around off and he slams it high and way over long on
squeezes away a full and wide one to point
good sharp take by slip to his left, it was bowled full and slid in straight on the pads, he went for a swing, and the ball carried to slip, umpire thinks there is no bat, there was a huge appeal
cannot work this one on leg stump away
turning away but dropped short, he rocks back and slaps it away over extra cover
tossed up slower through the air, comes forward and defends
fuller and outside off, slammed away to long off

and right away, he gets one to turn in to Gilly and raps him on the pads, Mishra implores, shouts, jumps in the air, but the umpire is unmoved, that was really close, in fact it is hitting leg, lucky Gilly
wide one outside off, swatted away down the ground towards long off
Adam Gilchrist tees off in to the crowd, length ball on his pads and he mows it over wide long on, this is the real one, not the scooping one
slower and fuller, he eases it in the air down the ground on the bounce to long off with a straight-batted loft
tries the bouncer, gets it on target and makes Paul duck
tries the pick-up shot over square leg, but misses and takes it on the pads
Sanga persists with Gony who delivers a harmless shortish one, Gilly rocks back and pulls it over midwicket in a flash
takes this back of a length ball from off stump and runs it down to third man
Gilchrist pushes a length ball towards covers and immediately shouts 'NO'
sees him backing away a long way outside leg and fires it in to him, he tries to swing it away but cannot connect
hammered off the back foot, he is just standing and thumping them, back of a length outside off but he cannot get it past cover
goes for a big pull, but this one is not short at all, and he mistimes it in to the ground
Gilly chops this one from outside off past the keeper, but third man cuts it off
Gony has already gone for plenty this over, and goes for one more boundary now, full and wide outside off stump, and Paul smashes it past point, third man had no chance at all
sprays this one short and wide outside off stump, Sanga saves four byes with a brilliant take
slower one from the back of the hand, but he gets this one away as well, slams it wide of the man at long off who dives to his left but cannot stop it
stays in the crease, brings front foot out and drives it back to the bowler
and another one, Paul can;t do anything wrong at the moment, comes down the track, and hammers a fuller one wide of mid off, and it carries all the way
just stands in the crease and mows this length ball over mid off, comfortably clears the man in the end
Calypso thwacko! Pual gets a helpful short one from Gony, and pulls it in the air on one leg through midwicket
uff, that is agricultural from Adam, normally he would have gone for the big swipe over the leg side, but he tries the pick-up shot over short fine leg and misses completely outside off
Ishant gets the leading edge and it settles in the hands of point easily, it was a full delivery on the pads, Paul was early on the flick and got the edge, but well, Ishant has overstepped, oh then
pings mid off with the front foot drive to a length ball
shortish and wide from Ishant outside off stump, Paul slashes hard at it, and gets it over point, wide of third man and all the way over the ropes
the bouncer now, outside off stump, and he lets it go
bangs this one in back of a length and gets good lift, Paul went for the forcing cut but it was too close to him and he is beaten
ishant tries the slower one but it goes wrong, ending up full and wide down the leg side, Paul tried to tap it away but missed
takes a step across to push a back of a length ball in front of extra cover, 'yeah, yeah, yeah' goes Adam, and they go through for the run
slower one from Steyn on the pads, he works it away towards midwicket
angled in on leg stump, Paul backs away and drives wide of extra cover, mid off dives across to save the boundary
gives him the furious bouncer, and Paul goes down underneath it
Gilchrist goes for the big swipe down the ground, but gets a steepling edge that is taken at extra cover, it is the free hit anyways
good comeback from Steyn, pacy fuller one that moves away late outside off and takes the outside edge down to third man, Steyn has overstepped
Steyn goes on the pads from a length, Paul uses the angle nicely to pick him over square leg and couple of bounces in to the boundary
looks to pull a ball that is not short enough, gets it off the bottom edge in front of square leg
wants to turn one on the pads through square leg, but gets a leading edge towards covers
slap! Gilly stays on the back foot, bends it in the end and slaps a fuller one past extra cover this time
stands in the crease waiting for this length ball to come on, takes a step out and punches hard to cover
goes for the pull over midwicket to a short one that climbs quickly on to him and just beats Gony running back from mid on
angles this across Gilly who goes for the whiplash cut but cannot beat backward point
pushed back to the bowler from the crease
hangs back in the crease, looking to go off side again, but Steyn rips this one from a length and past his weak waft
uses Steyn;s pace nicely this time, backs away a touch, this one moves away again, but short and he cut it over point and wide of third man
moves away sharply from short of a good length outside off, he tries to cut it from the crease but it climbs sharply past him
this one does not come back in, angles across outside off stump, he stays in the crease and steers it to third man
pacy length delivery coming in to Gilchrist, he plays it out on the leg side
Adam shuffles cross and gets this one off the pads and past short fine leg, boundary off the first ball
